channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Threat to Chicken Neck corridor can come from China, not Bangladesh: Brig Barthakur
item.description: The retired brigadier said Bangladesh lacks the capacity to threaten the Siliguri Corridor, warning that any real security concern could arise from China

item.title: Kaziranga tiger deaths highlight territorial stress in high-density habitat
item.description: Three tiger deaths due to infighting within 20 days have renewed concerns over rising tiger density, with conservationists warning of saturation

item.title: Assam’s push-back policy on Bangladesh nationals triggers diplomatic unease
item.description: Assam’s decision to expel within seven days has raised concerns in Dhaka, with Bangladesh stressing deportations must follow international law

item.title: RTI raises questions over Rs 16.8 lakh cash donations at Zubeen Kshetra
item.description: An RTI reply has raised concerns over transparency at Zubeen Kshetra after records showed nearly Rs 16.8 lakh collected entirely in cash

item.title: Tripura’s agarwood economy to touch Rs 2,000 Cr with policy push: Scindia
item.description: The DoNER minister said the agarwood economy could grow to Rs 2,000 crore annually, citing higher export caps, and a new Rs 80-crore cluster project

item.title: Assam’s state bird on the brink as White-winged Wood Duck faces extinction crisis
item.description: The white-winged wood duck now survives in only a few protected areas as habitat loss, industrial activity and lack of awareness push it towards extinction.

item.title: Manipur takes up first-ever rigid pavement works to address poor roads
item.description: The project with a cost of Rs 3,647.23 crore, of which a sum of Rs 2,896.02 crore is financed through an Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) loan.

item.title: Floods, erosion ravage Kordoiguri as students’ union warns of stir against govt
item.description: Relentless floods and riverbank erosion along the Dangori river continue to threaten Kordoiguri, prompting inspection by AASU and warning of protests

item.title: AASAA flags law & order crisis in Kokrajhar, seeks justice and compensation
item.description: The All Adivasi Students’ Association of Assam has raised concerns over continuing tensions in Karigaon, Kokrajhar, following violence linked to a road accident

item.title: PM likely to land on NE’s first highway-based emergency landing strip in Moran
item.description: Although vehicular movement is permitted, the runway stretch has been kept clear & operationally ready for February 14
